candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits TCP/443 from any source to the fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2 while the fw-01 HTTP (ASDM) server is enabled, so fw-01 HTTPS management is reachable from sources outside MGMT, contrary to the management policy.
candidates.remediation: Remove or restrict the rtr-01 EDGE_IN entry at seq 40 so that no non-MGMT source can reach HTTPS on fw-01's outside address.
